testCases.title: Page loads successfully with rent records
preconditions: User is logged in as Employee
testCases.expectedResult: Page loads without errors and displays the rent details dashboard

testCases.title: Rent records display with correct room and payment information
preconditions: User is logged in as Employee
At least 3 rooms exist with rent records
steps: Verify each row displays room number, tenant name, monthly rent amount, payment status, and due date
testCases.expectedResult: All rent records are visible with accurate data for each field

testCases.title: Pagination works correctly with multiple pages
preconditions: User is logged in as Employee
steps: Verify default page shows 10 records per page
Verify page number indicator updates and next set of records displays
testCases.expectedResult: Pagination controls work and records change correctly across pages

testCases.title: Filter by payment status updates displayed records
preconditions: User is logged in as Employee
steps: Click the payment status filter dropdown
Verify only pending records are displayed
testCases.expectedResult: Filter applies and shows only records matching the selected payment status

testCases.title: Empty state displays when no rent records exist
preconditions: User is logged in as Employee
No rent records exist in the system
steps: Verify main content area shows empty state message
testCases.expectedResult: Empty state displays a friendly message indicating no rent records found

testCases.title: Unauthorized access redirects to login page
testCases.expectedResult: User is redirected to /auth login page and cannot access rent details without authentication
